findings.body:
The newly added `mod egress;` line is unconditional, while the surrounding modules are conditionally compiled with `#[cfg(feature = "voice")]`. If `egress.rs` contains code that relies on the `voice` feature, building the crate without that feature will fail. Adding the same `#[cfg(feature = "voice")]` guard as the neighbouring modules prevents this potential compile‑time error.

**Concrete scenario:** compile the crate with default features (i.e., without `voice`). The compiler will attempt to compile `egress.rs` and may hit missing dependencies or undefined symbols, causing a build failure.
findings.title: Guard egress module with voice feature flag

value.summary: The change adds a private `egress` module but does not guard it with the `#[cfg(feature = "voice")]` attribute. If the module depends on the `voice` feature, this could cause compilation failures when the feature is disabled.
